==English==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alt|en|scite||dated|obsolete}}

===Etymology===
{{etymon|en|id=place|:inh|enm:site<ety:bor<xno:site>>}}
From {{inh|en|enm|site}}, from {{der|en|xno|site}}, from {{der|en|la|situs||position, place, site}}, from {{m|la|[[sino|sinere]]||to put, lay, set down, usually let, suffer, permit}}. {{doublet|en|sitio|situs}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{enPR|sīt}}, {{IPA|en|/saɪt/}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-site.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|aɪt|s=1}}
* {{homophones|en|cite|sight}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# The place where anything is fixed; situation; local position
#: {{usex|en|the '''site''' of a city or of a house}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1785|author=Henry Morris|title=Surgical diseases of the kidney|publisher=Lea Brothers and Co|pageurl=http://books.google.com/books?vid=OCLC09143761&id=UhNLA6DNKU4C&pg=RA5-PA74&lpg=RA5-PA74&dq=site+date:1781-1790&num=100|page=74
|passage=At the '''site''' of its termination in the bladder there was a diverticulum a few centimeters long.}}
#* {{RQ:Allingham China Governess|chapter=Foreword|passage=He turned back to the scene before him and the enormous new block of council dwellings. The design was some way after Corbusier but the block was built up on plinths and resembled an Atlantic liner swimming diagonally across the '''site'''.}}
#* {{RQ:Schuster Hepaticae|volume=V|page=vii|text=With fresh material, taxonomic conclusions are leavened by recognition that the material examined reflects the '''site''' it occupied; a herbarium packet gives one only a small fraction of the data desirable for sound conclusions. Herbarium material does not, indeed, allow one to extrapolate safely: what you see is what you get{{...}}}}
# A place fitted or chosen for any certain permanent use or occupation
#: {{usex|en|a '''site''' for a church}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1716|author=Samuel Wesley|title=The history of the Old and New Testament, attempted in verse: And adorn'd with Three Hundred & Thirty Sculptures|publisher=John Hooke|pageurl=http://books.google.com/books?vid=OCLC16069837&id=kA0DAAAAQAAJ&pg=RA14-PA192&lpg=RA14-PA192&dq=site+date:1701-1720&num=100|page=192
|passage=The Town surrender'd soon, the Citadel,/Proud of its '''Site''', do's their Assaults repel/Who e're their Idols cou'd, and them destroy,/For Life he shall the Gen'ral's place enjoy.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2006|author=Geoff Surratt; Greg Ligon; Warren Bird|title=The Multi-Site Church Revolution: Being One Church in Many Locations|publisher=Zondervan|isbn=0310270154|pageurl=http://books.google.com/books?vid=ISBN0310270154&id=ESUPZ3uKy8cC&pg=PA1&lpg=PA1&ots=hpud5jiuWu&dq=site+date:2006-2007&num=100&sig=Q5hhexlwel4BFgyaLme9pp_58UA#PPA7,M1|page=7
|passage=Our first '''site''' was the result of a building project that I am told was the first urban redevelopment initiated by a church since "white flight" began in the community surrounding our church.}}
# The posture or position of a thing.
#*: And if this be the Shape, and '''Site''', then the Refraction of the Rays coming from above onto the subjacent Ice, being as about Four to Three, they must when coming out of the superior Ice be as about Three to Four.
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1724|author=John Beaumont|title=Gleanings of Antiquities: containing, I. An Essay for Explaining the Creation and the Deluge, according to the Sense of the Gentiles...[full title extends to over 98 words]|publisher=W. Taylor|pageurl=http://books.google.com/books?vid=OCLC09246179&id=5GB5oSig_RMC&pg=RA2-PA11&lpg=RA2-PA11&dq=site+date:1721-1730&num=100|page=11
|passage=There is an Agreement ammong all their Authors regarding the Names of the said Times, and their Order, and concerning the Number of the Days in general, and of the Order of the Creation ; but concerning the '''Site''' of the Times, that is, in what Month, Day, and in what part of the Year they began, it is not so.}}
# A computer installation, particularly one associated with an [[intranet]] or [[internet]] [[service]] or [[telecommunications]].
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1982|author=Jack B. Rochester|title=Perspectives on Information Management: A Critical Selection of Computerworld Feature Articles|publisher=John Wiley & Sons|isbn=0471869244|pageurl=http://books.google.com/books?vid=ISBN0471869244&id=pb9Iussd540C&q=site+date:1982-1982&dq=site+date:1982-1982&num=100&pgis=1|page=433
|passage=The data may be divided among a data base system's nodes in several ways. In a fully redundant data base system, each data base '''site''' contains a complete copy of the entire data base...}}
#* '''1991''', V. Yodaiken, K. Ramamritham, ''Verification of a Reliable Net Protocol'', read in J. (Jan) Vytopil (editor), ''Formal Techniques in Real-Time and Fault-Tolerant Systems: Second International Symposium, Nijmegen, The Netherlands, January 1992: Proceedings'', Springer, {{ISBN|0387550925}}, [http://books.google.com/books?vid=ISBN3540550925&id=t1rRHxZo0AcC&pg=RA1-PA208&lpg=RA1-PA208&dq=site+date:1991-1991&num=100&sig=8Br7I2DEcUqfk3-jSd_R-xD34vI#PRA1-PA208,M1 p. 208],
#*: If the '''site''' is forced to send a message against its will,{{nb...}},we make the '''site''' go to an error state, and remain there. Note that the '''site''' can fail for other reasons.
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2006|author=Keith J. Dreyer|title=Pacs: A Guide to the Digital Revolution|publisher=Springer|isbn=0387260102|pageurl=http://books.google.com/books?vid=ISBN0387260102&id=xtN6nxWGf54C&pg=PP368&lpg=PP368&dq=site+date:2006-2007&num=100&sig=5Pz4gofsswKXL9XK8tmVZHVg1PA|page=298
|passage=The '''site''' with the DS3 connection can communicate back to our main network at 45 Mb/s.}}
# {{senseid|en|Q35127}}{{lb|en|Internet}} A [[website]].
#* '''1999''', Publisher's notes on relevant web sites, in front of Charlotte Bronte, ''Jane Eyre'', Wordsworth Editions (1999), {{ISBN|1853260207}}, [http://books.google.com/books?vid=ISBN1853260207&id=bfpaLNJhassC&pg=PR26&lpg=PR26&dq=site+web&num=100&sig=JfJyE0bDzocB9aqDdl0g1mEeY-Y#PPR26,M1 p. xxvi],
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2006|author=Doug Addison|title=Web Site Cookbook|publisher=O'Reilly|isbn=0596101090|pageurl=http://books.google.com/books?vid=ISBN0596101090&id=y-HXEhZWdm8C&pg=PA248&lpg=PA248&ots=2coLu_3ekm&dq=site+date:2006-2007&num=100&sig=-XfUZ4Xsi5sxDVHMlJAeFx00ALM|page=248
|passage=When a new visitor arrives at your '''site''', your web server should log the referring '''site''', which is generally either a search engine or another web site.}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|author=Adrianne Jeffries|title=The Daily Stormer just lost its new .cat domain|magazine={{w|The Outline (website)|The Outline}}|url=https://theoutline.com/post/2376/the-daily-stormer-just-lost-its-new-cat-domain|date=2017-10-06|passage=On September 21, white supremacist '''site''' The Daily Stormer, domainless after multiple providers dropped it over its coverage of the violent rally in Charlottesville, registered dailystormer.cat.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20260601044451/https://theoutline.com/post/2376/the-daily-stormer-just-lost-its-new-cat-domain|archivedate=1 June 2026}}
# {{lb|en|category theory}} A [[category]] together with a choice of [[Grothendieck topology]].
# Region of a protein, a piece of DNA or RNA where chemical reactions take place.
# A part of the [[body]] which has been [[operated]] on.

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# To [[situate]] or [[place]] a building or construction project.
#: {{ux|en|The U.K. government is dusting off an alternative plan to '''site''' the center at a military outfit such as [[Porton Down]].}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1835|title=Mining Journal|url=http://books.google.com/books?vid=OCLC37630157&id=ClAQAAAAIAAJ&q=%22to+site%22+date:1801-1850&dq=%22to+site%22+date:1801-1850&num=100&pgis=1
|passage=A reassessment of the requirements of the gold mining industry, including uranium production, for the next few years has revealed the urgent necessity for the provision of additional power, and steps have been taken to '''site''' and plan a new station.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2006|author=Mark Jaccard|title=Sustainable Fossil Fuels: The Unusual Suspect in the Quest for Clean And Enduring Energy|publisher=Cambridge University Press|isbn=0521861799|pageurl=http://books.google.com/books?vid=ISBN0521861799&id=3L957CerahoC&pg=PA22&lpg=PA22&dq=%22to+site%22+date:2006-2007&num=100&sig=XHg35JB4KnuXupHEdt151oExpeU|page=22
|passage=It is difficult to gauge current public attitudes to nuclear power in industrialized countries because there have been few efforts to '''site''' and construct new plants in the last twenty years.}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|year=2006|journal=The Scotsman (15 Dec 06)
|passage=Fury at plan to '''site''' homeless hostel near top Capital school.}}
#* {{RQ:en:New York Times|author=Ezra Klein|title=Transcript: Ezra Klein Interviews Jesse Jenkins|date=2022-09-20|url=https://www.nytimes.com/2022/09/20/podcasts/transcript-ezra-klein-interviews-jesse-jenkins.html|quotee=Jesse Jenkins|passage={{...|And so even though transmission lines are especially bulk transmission lines are clearly related to interstate commerce and that Congress has used the Commerce Clause and the fact that the federal government should regulate interstate commerce to enact all kinds of Federal Regulations over wholesale or bulk power generation,}} they have not expanded so far federal permitting authority to '''site''' and permit transmission lines that are important for interstate commerce.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20251029122741/https://www.nytimes.com/2022/09/20/podcasts/transcript-ezra-klein-interviews-jesse-jenkins.html|archivedate=29 October 2025}}
